{{Quote|Like you, I was born into captivity, shackled by the crimes of my ancestors. Our forefathers rot in the bowels of this prison, their debt to the Republic repaid in full. Yet here we remain, guiltless.|Nyranos|<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Riot in the Warden's Station|Belsavis}}</ref>}}
'''SIS Order J-V326-0987P''' was a directive issued by the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] intelligence agency, involving the descendants of criminals incarcerated at the [[Belsavis prison|prison complex]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. The order decreed that the descendants of prisoners born on Belsavis were never allowed to emigrate off of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], despite repeated appeals to the prison warden. The directive gave rise to the rebellious group of second-generation prisoners known as the [[Condemned]], led by the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Nyranos]].<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The SIS order was first mentioned, albeit indirectly, in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]]-[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" /> It was first identified by name in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
